transcript.text: Last spring when I was in Beijing, I remember we kept bouncing between neighborhoods just trying to decide where to eat.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One place that stuck in my head was Green Lotus—my cousin had picked it out and kept talking about it afterward.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That lunch thing they did was on 2025-05-12, and it was a huge group—like 10 people, which sounded kind of chaotic.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I’m pretty sure they showed up around 14:00, and the contact name on it was Song Qi.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh—and for some reason I still remember the phone they used, 13888990011. Also, that same Beijing trip, we were chatting about movies the whole time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker Chen Ming ended up going solo to see The Wandering Earth 3 at Bona International—one ticket—and the showtime he mentioned was 10:30.
